ValidationRule.description: Channel IS Mandatory for CCRM Leads WHEN Type IN (‘Inbound’ OR ‘Inbound/Outbound') THEN values IN (MLCRM, CCRM) WHEN Type IN (‘Outbound’) THEN values IN (CCRM) OTHERWISE value Not Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") && OR(ISCHANGED(Channel__c),ISCHANGED(Type)) && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type,'') ) && IF( CASE(Text(Type), "Inbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "CCRM",1, "MLCRM",1, "",0, 1), "Inbound / Outbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "CCRM",1, "MLCRM",1, "",0, 1), "Outbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "MLCRM",0, "CCRM",1, "",0, 1), 1)=0, true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Channel Value with selected Type.
